color.note: Two kinds of colour. Canvas-facing tokens (canvas-*, mark-*, level-*) follow the editor's light and dark themes. Material tokens are a part's own paint and are identical in both themes: a part looks the same on any canvas, as a real part does on any bench.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The canvas behind every part.

tokens.name: canvas-ink
tokens.usage: currentColor on the canvas: pin names outside a chip's leads, logic symbols, outline parts. On canvas.

tokens.name: canvas-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Value captions under passive parts (220 Ω) and secondary canvas text. On canvas.

tokens.name: canvas-grid
tokens.usage: The pitch-grid dots behind artwork in previews and the editor grid.

tokens.name: mark-select
tokens.usage: Selection outline around a part and a hovered pin handle: indigo, a step away from level-low blue. Never inside artwork.

tokens.name: mark-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, a selected wire's end handles, and the ring on an occupied breadboard hole.

tokens.name: mark-pin-connected
tokens.usage: A wired pin's handle dot, inside mark-pin-connected-ring.

tokens.name: mark-pin-connected-ring
tokens.usage: The light ring around a wired pin's handle.

tokens.name: mark-hole-hover
tokens.usage: The free breadboard hole under the pointer (ring and 25% fill).

tokens.name: mark-flow
tokens.usage: The editor's current wire dashes (its value today). Moves to signal when the editor adopts the kit.

tokens.name: mark-waypoint
tokens.usage: Bend handles on a selected wire.

tokens.name: level-high
tokens.usage: A logic output lead solved HIGH (data-level-pin). The editor's own value; beside level-low it is 1.07:1, hue alone, so the editor also writes data-level="high" on the lead and the pin tooltip carries the voltage.

tokens.name: level-low
tokens.usage: A logic output lead solved LOW (data-level-pin). The editor's own value; see level-high for how the pair is told apart beyond hue.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one live colour, the brand's Signal: the probe on a pin, current flowing along a leg or wire, the selected pin. Never a material, never decoration; if it is yellow, it is happening now.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: The probe tip and any text on signal.

tokens.name: pcb-blue
tokens.usage: Default board finish for display and sensor modules (OLED, TM1637, MAX7219, relay, RFID). Silk on it is silk.

tokens.name: pcb-blue-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-blue board.

tokens.name: pcb-green
tokens.usage: Board finish for RP2040-class boards, character LCD modules and e-paper carriers. Silk on it is silk.

tokens.name: pcb-green-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-green board.

tokens.name: pcb-teal
tokens.usage: Board finish for Uno, Nano and Mega-class boards (the family people recognise by its colour, drawn without any vendor mark). Silk on it is silk. New in this system.

tokens.name: pcb-teal-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-teal board.

tokens.name: pcb-black
tokens.usage: Board finish for ESP32 dev kits and instruments. Silk on it is silk.

tokens.name: pcb-black-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-black board.

tokens.name: pcb-purple
tokens.usage: Board finish for small sensor breakouts (BMP180, DHT, HC-SR04 and the like). Silk on it is silk.

tokens.name: pcb-purple-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-purple board.

tokens.name: pcb-white
tokens.usage: Board finish for Nucleo-class boards. Silk on it is silk-dark.

tokens.name: pcb-white-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-white board.

tokens.name: pcb-red
tokens.usage: Board finish for the 2.4 inch TFT module and other red breakouts. Silk on it is silk (10.6:1).

tokens.name: pcb-red-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a pcb-red board.

tokens.name: silk
tokens.usage: Silkscreen print on every dark finish (pcb-blue, pcb-green, pcb-teal, pcb-black, pcb-purple): titles and pin labels. 4.5:1 or better on each.

tokens.name: silk-dark
tokens.usage: Silkscreen print on pcb-white.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Gold through-hole pads, SMD pads and mount-hole rings on every finish.

tokens.name: hole
tokens.usage: A drilled hole through a board or housing: it shows the canvas, so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: cavity
tokens.usage: A dark opening that is not a through-hole: a socket, a microphone port, a jack bore, a vent.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Chip body: DIP, SOIC, TSSOP and the controller on a module. chip-print reads on it at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: chip-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of a chip body.

tokens.name: chip-print
tokens.usage: Part number, pin-1 notch and pin numbers printed on chip.

tokens.name: lead
tokens.usage: Metal leads and legs: chip leads, LED and resistor legs, header pins.

tokens.name: lead-edge
tokens.usage: The dark backing under every lead and leg, so a wire reads as round and keeps 3:1 against a white canvas.

tokens.name: plastic-black
tokens.usage: Black plastic: button bodies, header housings, buzzer and pot cases, LCD bezels, SMD parts on modules.

tokens.name: plastic-black-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-black.

tokens.name: plastic-grey
tokens.usage: Grey plastic: potentiometer and switch bodies, display frames.

tokens.name: plastic-grey-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-grey.

tokens.name: plastic-white
tokens.usage: White plastic: sensor housings, cable connectors, the Pico's button.

tokens.name: plastic-white-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-white.

tokens.name: plastic-blue
tokens.usage: Blue plastic: the DHT11's housing, the one sensor people know by its colour; the trimmers, the servo, the relay module's relay and screw terminal, and the keypad's number keys.

tokens.name: plastic-blue-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-blue.

tokens.name: plastic-red
tokens.usage: Red plastic: the DIP switch's body and the keypad's letter and symbol keys.

tokens.name: plastic-red-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-red.

tokens.name: plastic-amber
tokens.usage: Amber plastic: the KS2E relay's can.

tokens.name: plastic-amber-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of plastic-amber.

tokens.name: metal
tokens.usage: Bright metal: sensor cans, USB shells, screw terminals, metal lids.

tokens.name: metal-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of metal.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass parts: the SW-520D tilt switch's gilded can.

tokens.name: brass-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of brass parts.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: An unlit display window (OLED, TFT, TV). The run paints over it on a canvas.

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: The frame around a glass display window.

tokens.name: resistor-body
tokens.usage: Axial resistor body. Bands read on it; band-white and band-yellow get the stroke-fine edge.

tokens.name: resistor-body-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of resistor-body.

tokens.name: resistor-smd
tokens.usage: SMD resistors and small dark parts drawn on modules.

tokens.name: band-black
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 0.

tokens.name: band-brown
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 1.

tokens.name: band-red
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 2.

tokens.name: band-orange
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 3.

tokens.name: band-yellow
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 4.

tokens.name: band-green
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 5.

tokens.name: band-blue
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 6.

tokens.name: band-violet
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 7.

tokens.name: band-grey
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 8.

tokens.name: band-white
tokens.usage: Resistor colour code 9.

tokens.name: band-gold
tokens.usage: Multiplier ×0.1 and the 5% tolerance band.

tokens.name: band-silver
tokens.usage: Multiplier ×0.01 and the 10% tolerance band.

tokens.name: lens-red
tokens.usage: Red LED lens and button cap; the default lens. Lit at full opacity, unlit at opacity-lens-off.

tokens.name: lens-green
tokens.usage: Green LED lens, board power indicator, button cap.

tokens.name: lens-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow LED lens, the user LED on boards, button cap.

tokens.name: lens-blue
tokens.usage: Blue LED lens and button cap.

tokens.name: lens-white
tokens.usage: White LED lens and button cap.

tokens.name: lens-orange
tokens.usage: Orange LED lens and button cap.

tokens.name: indicator-off
tokens.usage: An unlit SMD indicator on a dark finish.

tokens.name: indicator-off-light
tokens.usage: An unlit SMD indicator on pcb-white.

tokens.name: cap-electrolytic
tokens.usage: Electrolytic capacitor can, top view, with a cap-stripe segment on the negative side.

tokens.name: cap-stripe
tokens.usage: The polarity stripe on cap-electrolytic and the print on resistor-smd.

tokens.name: cap-ceramic
tokens.usage: Ceramic disc capacitors and SMD capacitors on modules.

tokens.name: cap-mlcc
tokens.usage: The brown multilayer ceramic chip capacitors on the small sensor boards.

tokens.name: bread-body
tokens.usage: Breadboard body, the default white. bread-print and bread-hole read on it.

tokens.name: bread-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stroke of bread-body.

tokens.name: bread-hole
tokens.usage: Breadboard holes on bread-body.

tokens.name: bread-print
tokens.usage: Row numbers and column letters on bread-body.

tokens.name: rail-plus
tokens.usage: The + stripe along a breadboard power rail.

tokens.name: rail-minus
tokens.usage: The − stripe along a breadboard power rail.

tokens.name: lcd-green
tokens.usage: Character LCD glass with the green backlight on. lcd-ink reads on it.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: Characters on lcd-green.

tokens.name: lcd-blue
tokens.usage: Character LCD glass with the blue backlight on. lcd-ink-light reads on it.

tokens.name: lcd-ink-light
tokens.usage: Characters on lcd-blue.

tokens.name: segment-face
tokens.usage: The face of a seven-segment display or LED matrix.

tokens.name: segment-off
tokens.usage: An unlit segment or matrix dot on segment-face. A lit one takes its lens token.

tokens.name: readout
tokens.usage: An instrument's own small display (the logic analyzer, the NeoPixel meter).

tokens.name: readout-text
tokens.usage: Live digits on readout.

tokens.name: readout-dim
tokens.usage: Idle or secondary text on readout.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: A reading within range on readout or segment-face.

tokens.name: status-near
tokens.usage: A reading near its limit.

tokens.name: status-over
tokens.usage: A reading over its limit.

groups.name: Printed on the part
groups.note: Artwork pixels at 1:1; the canvas is usually zoomed 2× to 4×. Monospace, because pin names line up in rows.

styles.name: part-number
styles.usage: The part number on a chip body, rotated along the body's long side, in chip-print.

styles.name: pin-name
styles.usage: Pin names outside a chip's leads, in canvas-ink (currentColor).

styles.name: silk-title
styles.usage: A module's or board's title, in silk or silk-dark.

styles.name: module-print
styles.usage: Secondary silkscreen: pin labels on wide boards, polarity marks.

styles.name: pin-label
styles.usage: Pin labels beside header pads, in silk; pin numbers inside a DIP body, in chip-print; the smallest print on a part. 4px is 3pt at the kit's scale, the floor SparkFun's Fritzing guide sets.

styles.name: readout-digits
styles.usage: Live digits on an instrument's readout.

groups.name: Beside the part
groups.note: Drawn by the editor, not the artwork. Theme-aware.

styles.name: value-caption
styles.usage: The value caption under a passive part, in canvas-ink-muted on canvas.

styles.name: pin-tooltip
styles.usage: The live pin label on hover.

spacing.note: One unit: 0.1 inch (2.54 mm) is 9.6 px at 96 dpi, the breadboard hole pitch. Every pin of a part sits on this pitch relative to its first pin; bodies are sized in pitches and rounded to 0.01 px.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: 0.1 inch. Pin-to-pin distance in a row; the unit every body is measured in.

tokens.name: pitch-half
tokens.usage: Half a pitch: a leg's offset inside a two-pitch-wide part, a hole's reveal radius.

tokens.name: pitch-2
tokens.usage: 0.2 inch: SOIC and TSSOP row span, the space between logic-symbol inputs.

tokens.name: pitch-3
tokens.usage: 0.3 inch: DIP row span, so a chip straddles a breadboard's centre channel.

tokens.name: pin-margin
tokens.usage: 0.8 pitch from a board's edge to its first pin row.

tokens.name: lead-length
tokens.usage: How far a chip lead shows beyond the body.

tokens.name: lead-width
tokens.usage: Stroke width of a chip lead.
tokens.note: A chip's lead from body to pad: 2.9px, 0.03 in, Fritzing's minimum leg width.

tokens.name: leg-width
tokens.usage: Stroke width of a component leg (LED, resistor, TO-92, capacitor).
tokens.note: A standing part's leg: 2.3px of lead inside a 0.6px metal-edge outline, 2.9px drawn, which is 0.03 in, the width Fritzing's graphic standards set for legs.

tokens.name: pad-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of a through-hole pad.

tokens.name: hole-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of the hole inside a pad.

tokens.name: mount-hole-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of a board's corner mounting hole.

tokens.name: board-inset
tokens.usage: The board rectangle sits this far inside the artwork box so its edge stroke is not clipped.

tokens.name: label-rise
tokens.usage: Baseline of a pin label above its pad centre.

tokens.name: label-drop
tokens.usage: Baseline of a pin label below its pad centre.

radius.note: Small and real: parts are rounded only where the moulding is.

tokens.name: radius-board
tokens.usage: Board corners.

tokens.name: radius-bezel
tokens.usage: Display bezels and glass.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chip bodies.

tokens.name: radius-part
tokens.usage: SMD pads, small plastic parts, cans.

tokens.name: radius-detail
tokens.usage: Connector housings, contacts, slots.

stroke.note: Flat paint with one darker edge stroke per body. No gradients, shadows or filters; the lit lens glow is the one exception, drawn as a translucent circle.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: The edge stroke on every body: boards, chips, plastics, metal.

tokens.name: stroke-detail
tokens.usage: Edges inside a body: legs' feet, resistor body, small parts on modules.

tokens.name: stroke-fine
tokens.usage: Hairlines: band edges, text underlines, matrix cell gaps.

tokens.name: stroke-symbol
tokens.usage: Logic symbols and other outline parts drawn in canvas-ink.

opacity.note: State is shown by opacity, never by a second palette; volume by two overlays at opacity-light and opacity-shade.

tokens.name: opacity-lens-off
tokens.usage: An unlit lens over plastic-grey.

tokens.name: opacity-glow
tokens.usage: The halo around a lit lens at full brightness; scale by brightness.

tokens.name: opacity-segment-dim
tokens.usage: The floor of a graded segment or bar (0.25 + 0.75 × level).

tokens.name: opacity-light
tokens.usage: The white light overlay along the top or left of every cylinder and dome: the bench light comes from the top left.

tokens.name: opacity-shade
tokens.usage: The black shade overlay along the bottom or right of every cylinder and dome.

tokens.name: opacity-heat
tokens.usage: A band-red overlay on a resistor body at full heat (scaled by how close it is to its rating).

tokens.name: opacity-flow
tokens.usage: Signal dashes along a leg while current flows; 0 when it does not.
